name: deploys-software
definition: An organization installs, hosts, or operates a specific software product or system.

name: is-part-of
definition: An organization or organizational unit is a component or subdivision of another body.

name: uses-email-address
definition: An entity uses an email address for communication or point of contact.

name: associated-with-malware
definition: The threat actor or group is linked to or operates the specified malware.

name: contains-file
definition: An archive or container file encapsulates another specified file.

name: exfiltrates-data-to
definition: A malware program transmits stolen data to a remote network endpoint or domain.

name: tracks-activity-using
definition: Identifies an activity tracking identifier associated with the use of a specific tool or malware family.

name: routes-traffic-through
definition: Indicates that network communication passes through an intermediary network or proxy service.

name: hosts-file
definition: Indicates that an internet domain or web server hosts a specific downloadable file.

name: creates-file
definition: The source file decodes, extracts, or writes the target file to the system.

name: downloads-and-executes
definition: The source file initiates the download and execution of the target payload.

name: impersonates
definition: The head entity falsely portrays itself as or mimics the brand, identity, or resource of the tail entity.

name: hosted-on-infrastructure-of
definition: The head network resource is hosted on the infrastructure or network provided by the tail service provider.

name: registered-with
definition: The head domain or URL resource was registered through the tail registrar or service provider.

name: located-in
definition: The head entity is physically, administratively, or geographically located in the tail country or jurisdiction.

name: targets-entities-in
definition: The subject malware or attack campaign targets organizations or individuals located in the object country.

name: exploits-vulnerability
definition: The subject file, script, or campaign leverages a specific security vulnerability.

name: delivers-payload
definition: The subject file or dropper executes, drops, or installs the object malware payload.

name: is-instance-of
definition: Indicates that a specific file is a compiled binary or artifact belonging to a given malware family.

name: conducts-campaign
definition: Specifies that a threat actor is responsible for or deploys a particular malicious artifact or campaign.

name: associated-with
definition: Identifies an association between a threat actor and a campaign, tool, or malicious activity.

name: executes
definition: Indicates that a specific file or binary runs a particular program or malware family.

name: uses-tool
definition: The threat actor utilizes the specified tool, malware, or utility in operations.

name: communicates-with-domain
definition: The malware contacts or establishes network communication with the specified domain name.

name: acts-as-c2-for
definition: Specifies that a domain or IP address serves as command-and-control infrastructure for a malware family.

name: drops
definition: Writes or deposits a secondary payload or file onto the host storage.

name: spreads-via
definition: The campaign or threat activity is distributed or advertised across the specified platform.

name: launches-executable
definition: The source file or script initiates the execution of the target executable program.

name: obfuscates-file
definition: The source software tool is used to protect or obfuscate the code of the target file.

name: hosts-url
definition: The source domain hosts the network resource specified by the target URL.

name: downloads-from
definition: The malware or actor downloads data or payloads from the specified hosting service or server.

name: abuses-service
definition: The actor or malware leverages a legitimate third-party service or domain for malicious purposes.

name: uses-infrastructure
definition: The threat actor or activity utilizes specific network infrastructure such as domains, URLs, or servers.

name: infects-file
definition: The actor or malware modifies, injects code into, or compromises a specific target file.

name: uses-lure
definition: The threat actor uses a specific fictitious theme, scheme, or brand name as social engineering bait.
